Thanks everyone — this is exactly the kind of lightweight policy we need so reps don't have to escalate mid-quarter. Agreed approach:

- Principle: Redwood retains named-opportunity ownership for any active sales-opportunity in SFDC at the time BrightScale raises an interest.
- Exception: If an account is unassigned and BrightScale brings an integration-led, technical POC that materially speeds deployment, we will mark it as joint pipeline and route to the partner GTM owner (Jordan) to manage outreach.
- Conflict Ops: For contested accounts, follow Marcus's MO: 30-day integration-intro window post-close + co-marketing if incremental ARR threshold met. Any dispute beyond that goes to sales leadership for arbitration (Lauren to escalate).

Next steps: Jordan — publish partner_account_matrix.csv to the shared Drive and create a single-sheet carve-out doc titled "Partner Field Assignment v1". Priya — coordinate a 30-min alignment call with Sophie next week and attach the mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.link). Marcus — leave OP-197 as-is until Sophie confirms acceptance of the terms.

I'll consider this approved for regional rollout; if any of you see material downstream risk, flag me by EOD Tuesday.
